title: pane.wait
description: Waits on the caller's own pane until its shell finishes a command, draws its next prompt or its program writes anything, or the pane closes, or the timeout passes. Needs hello version 2 and a caller in a pane; any other pane is refused. At most 64 waits are parked in the core at once, and past that a wait is refused as busy. A wait whose connection closes is dropped.

pane.description: "self", or the caller's own pane number. Other panes are refused.

until.description: exit: OSC 133 D. prompt: OSC 133 A. output: any bytes from the program. Output can fake the marks.

outcome.description: What ended the wait. A timeout is a result, not an error.

exit.description: With exit only: the status the shell gave in its D mark, or null if it gave none.
